sources.title: Samir-Guenchi/llm-summarizer-from-scratch - GitHub
sources.snippet: This project implements a custom Transformer-based Large Language Model (LLM) specifically designed for abstractive text summarization. Unlike typical implementations that rely on high-level libraries like Hugging Face Transformers, this project builds every component from the ground up, providing deep insights into the inner workings of modern language models.
